replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
First off, I agree with Roman - you should add more close-up pictures.

From what I can see, the general idea of the map looks good. It's quite simple but, from what I can see, the general gameplay would be pretty nice. However, the two sides of the map are too far apart (imo) and there isn't enough room right now. I would just consider expanding upon the map.

But so far, great job! :)

replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
Too much void.
Less void, more islands. 
The monuments are way too close to spawn and need more platform around them IMO.
Also note that you have water, soul sand, cobwebs, and fences within the same area. I would have rage quit before even one block is placed just from attempting to bypass that catastrophe. 

Aesthetically, it seems a little flat, lacking landscaping and depth which could help a map feel more complete.
